rationale: Heartbeat renewal now uses a conditional SQL update over heartbeat-owning states, making it mutually exclusive with the cleanup claim CAS.
Cleanup claims now renew expires_at for the bounded cleanup ownership window in the same atomic update.
A typed cleanup-ownership loss now routes coordinator finalization to janitor-required waiting without host stop or Provider Profile release.
Lease-scoped drain, stop, remove, eviction, and stale-reconciliation actions now share the atomic cleanup claim before side effects.
Orphan cleanup now reloads the host lease identified by the container label and leaves lease-owned containers to the fenced cleanup path.
Informational Codex review envelope; its five child threads contain the complete actionable feedback.
